description: A React component for a modal dialog that allows adding groups to a team in Mattermost. It manages group selection, search, pagination, and linking groups to a team.

classes.name: AddGroupsToTeamModal
classes.description: A React component class for the modal dialog to add groups to a team.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches groups not associated with the team and all associated groups when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles search term changes with debounce to fetch filtered groups.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets the search term.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Handles modal exit, focusing back to the origin element.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles the response after attempting to link groups, updating error state.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits selected groups to be added to the team, optionally calling a callback.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a selected group to the current selection.

methods.name: setGroupsLoadingState
methods.description: Sets the loading state for group fetching.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Removes selected groups from the current selection.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Updates the search term for filtering groups.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders a group option in the multiselect dropdown.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders the display name of a selected group.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with group selection UI.
